panels.description: Cost breakdown by repository. Requires repository.fullname in OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES via .claude/settings.json.
panels.title: Cost by Repository

panels.description: Breakdown of tool executions by type. High 'Agent' percentage indicates agentic/delegated work patterns (vibe coding).
panels.title: Tool Usage Distribution (Agent = Vibe Coding)

panels.description: Total cost / total LOC * 1000. When LOC < 1000 this extrapolates (e.g. $1 for 50 lines = $20 per 1000 lines). Shows 'No LOC data yet' when no lines have been tracked.
panels.title: Cost per 1000 LOC

panels.description: Daily cost per user. Uses 1-day windows to reliably capture API call cost bursts — shorter windows miss costs when Claude Code API calls complete faster than the 15s Prometheus scrape interval. Legend sum is approximate; see 'Cost by User' table for precise totals.
panels.title: Cost Over Time by User

panels.description: Total cost divided by number of active users in the selected time range.
panels.title: Avg Cost per User

panels.description: Materialized ~30-day snapshot from the prompt-intent / prompt-lang exporter (Prometheus gauge), read in <1ms instead of scanning Loki. Reflects roughly the last 30 days and is independent of the time picker.
panels.title: Avg Prompts per User

panels.description: Total cost divided by total Claude Code active processing time. Active time excludes idle time while developer reads responses or writes prompts.
panels.title: Cost per Active Hour

panels.description: Cost breakdown by git hosting platform (github.com, gitea, bitbucket.org, gitlab.com, etc.).
panels.title: Cost by Git Host

panels.description: Cost breakdown by terminal or IDE. Named IDEs (pycharm, vscode, windsurf, cursor, phpstorm) are reported directly. 'non-interactive' typically indicates an IDE extension running Claude Code as a background subprocess.
panels.title: Cost by Terminal / IDE

panels.description: Materialized ~30-day snapshot from the prompt-intent / prompt-lang exporter (Prometheus gauge), read in <1ms instead of scanning Loki. Reflects roughly the last 30 days and is independent of the time picker.
panels.title: Total Prompts

panels.description: Materialized ~30-day snapshot from the prompt-intent / prompt-lang exporter (Prometheus gauge), read in <1ms instead of scanning Loki. Reflects roughly the last 30 days and is independent of the time picker.
panels.title: Cost per Prompt
